notes: The article on `כְּפִיר` is `unrepresented` because the ASV renders the rectum indefinitely (*a lion*), which is rule 29's indefinite-rectum case: nothing is fronted and the phrase's single *the* is the supplied determiner of the predicate noun.
`זַעַף מֶלֶךְ` is recast as an English possessive, so the determiner at the left edge stands before the possessor's word and goes to `מֶלֶךְ` under rule 29 even though that noun carries no article.
The first colon's predicate is a nominal, so its copula joins `נַהַם` under rule 20; the second colon's predicate is the `כְּ` phrase, so its copula joins the preposition under rule 49.
